items.source: Return the metadata entries for RSocketRequester.MetadataSpec.metadata(Object, MimeType).
items.translation: 返回 `RSocketRequester.MetadataSpec.metadata(Object, MimeType)` 的元数据条目。

items.source: Return the element type for a Publisher payload.
items.translation: 返回 `<a href="#getPayload()">Publisher` 负载的元素类型。

items.source: This is mutually exclusive with getPayload(). Only one of the two or neither is set.
items.translation: 这与getPayload()互斥。两者中只能设置一个，或者都不设置。

items.source: This is mutually exclusive with getPayloadValue(). Only one of the two or neither is set.
items.translation: 这与getPayloadValue()互斥。两者中仅设置其中一个，或都不设置。

items.source: Container for RSocket request values extracted from an @RSocketExchange-annotated method and argument values passed to it. This is then used to define a request via RSocketRequester.
items.translation: 用于存储从带有 `@RSocketExchange` 注解的方法中提取的 RSocket 请求值以及传递给该方法的参数值的容器。随后，通过 `RSocketRequester` 定义请求。
用于构建RSocketRequestValues的 Builder。

items.source: Return the request payload as a Publisher.
items.translation: 将请求负载作为 Publisher 返回。

items.source: Return the request payload as a value to be serialized, if set.
items.translation: 如果已设置，则将请求负载作为要序列化的值返回。
